list: Official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18 (names, descriptions and grades agree across both). No online trophies: the whole list is single-player. 27 trophies are visible on PlayStation, 28 stay hidden until earned.
note: Guides below are written in our own words for this guide. Where a fact comes from a launch-day guide it is named beside the trophy; where no walkthrough detail is confirmed yet (the game launched 2026-11-19) the guide says so plainly and sticks to what the official description itself tells you. Never invent a location or a step.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. Work the roadmap stages in order; the trophy you will most likely finish on is A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn; just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by finishing its story missions. Story progress only, nothing to prepare. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before this chapter ends, though: that meditation is reported to disappear afterwards.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by finishing its story missions. Story progress only; it unlocks when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by finishing its story missions. Story progress only; it unlocks when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by finishing its story missions. Story progress only. The optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...' opens up bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal, so take it when it appears.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Several launch lists word it as Chapter 5, but the official description only names the final mission; either way, finish the story and it unlocks. Nothing to prepare beyond getting there.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Story only; it unlocks when the mission ends, with no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Story only; it unlocks when the mission ends, with no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Story only; it unlocks when the mission ends, with no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story only; it unlocks when the mission ends, with no extra requirement.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Story only; it unlocks when the mission ends, with no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only; it unlocks when the mission ends, with no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. PowerPyx and GTABase both rank this the hardest trophy in the set, but PowerPyx notes the checklist thresholds are lenient, roughly 60% of true completion, and most of the progress comes from the other trophies anyway. Leave it for after the story and work through the checklist; it is the natural last trophy before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count, and flying under bridges is reported as the quickest kind. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so this trophy comes first if you keep stunt hunting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample every activity as you find it instead of grinding one: fishing, racing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest of the open-world pastimes each tick one type off.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every challenge at the range, weapon by weapon; the 100% checklist also asks for all 42, so there is no shortcut around the full set.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location: 14 locations in all. PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 spots, so winning one race at each location is enough; you do not need to win all 42.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race wins count, across road, drone and other race types. The 100% checklist asks for 30, so this trophy arrives on the way to that.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. No further detail is confirmed in the launch-day guides, so the description itself is the guide for now.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade game, play it through to its end and finish it; the shortest one you enjoy is the sensible choice.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's stranger mission chain. TechWiser reports these stranger chains have windows linked to story progress, so begin Andy's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it to the end. That warning comes from one source and is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.watch: Story-window warning (TechWiser, single source): start this stranger chain as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's stranger mission chain. TechWiser reports these stranger chains have windows linked to story progress, so begin Kenton's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it to the end. That warning comes from one source and is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.watch: Story-window warning (TechWiser, single source): start this stranger chain as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger mission chain. TechWiser reports these stranger chains have windows linked to story progress, so begin Billy's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it to the end. That warning comes from one source and is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.watch: Story-window warning (TechWiser, single source): start this stranger chain as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Work through stranger chains as they appear on the map; the five character-final trophies above count toward the eight, so finish those chains and add three more strands from other strangers.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.watch: Story-window warning (TechWiser, single source): stranger chains may have windows linked to story progress.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger mission chain. TechWiser reports these stranger chains have windows linked to story progress, so begin Randy's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it to the end. That warning comes from one source and is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.watch: Story-window warning (TechWiser, single source): start this stranger chain as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger mission chain. TechWiser reports these stranger chains have windows linked to story progress, so begin Tyrone's chain as soon as it unlocks rather than leaving it to the end. That warning comes from one source and is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.watch: Story-window warning (TechWiser, single source): start this stranger chain as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. GTABase counts 18 spots; the 100% checklist counts 15, and the two sources disagree, so treat the exact total as unconfirmed and meditate at every spot you find. POSSIBLY MISSABLE, do this early: GTABase and PowerPyx both flag this as the only trophy that might be missable, because the first meditation, Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is reported to disappear once that chapter ends, and it is unconfirmed whether it is required. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.watch: POSSIBLY MISSABLE: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house is reported to disappear after Chapter 1 (GTABase + PowerPyx). Do it in Chapter 1.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand and take the hunt it offers. Which animal it is has not been confirmed in the launch-day guides, so do not trust any named animal until a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect cards as you explore Leonida and finish any three sets. The 100% checklist asks for 15 sets, so three comes well before completion.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots around Leonida. The 100% checklist asks for the same 100, so this trophy and that checklist line finish together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Any 50 challenges count, across every challenge type. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so this trophy arrives on the way to that.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build up to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone. PowerPyx and GTABase both point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route, and bank vault robberies often bring on the wanted level you need.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row while still wanted; North Vice City's jewelry stores sit close together, which GTABase recommends. If it does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. According to GTABase you scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK, with no need to drive them, and scanning traffic near busy roads is efficient. Keep the phone out while you travel and scan as you go.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill Focus before you start, then drop five enemies in one activation. GTABase reports gang members count while cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to, so pick a gang fight for the attempt.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. GTABase's method: steal a docked passenger jet at VCIA and fly about 1 km away from it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank: get into one and use it. GTABase's method is to steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. EGamers, summarising GTABase: open the jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code and clear out the safe without anyone spotting you. Plan the entry and leave before the alarm goes up.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. This opens up after the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is...', after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars, and have a fast bike ready for the escape. The 100% checklist asks for 8 vaults, so this trophy comes first.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, rob it and get away clean; keep a fast getaway vehicle nearby before you start.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: all 52 areas. Clear the fog across the whole map; flying over the dark patches is reported as the quickest method. It finishes naturally as you travel for the other trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang: one operation from each of the 9 gangs. GTABase lists 9 gangs in all; work through them as you find their operations.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx marks the steps as not yet known, so no specific bar or spot is confirmed in the launch-day guides. Head to Ocean Beach and look for a bar with a view; do not trust any named spot until a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. GTABase's unconfirmed guess is crashing a car out through a showroom window, and PowerPyx marks the method as not yet known. Treat any specific method as unconfirmed until a launch guide verifies it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play bowling at that alley; the exact trigger is unclear in the launch lists, so play a full game there and follow through on your throws.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. GTABase reports this as maxing out Strength for both characters, but that comes from a single source and is unconfirmed; treat it as the best current lead, not a verified method.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. GTABase links this to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change it, from a single source. Play naturally and check the profile as it grows. Before going on a rampage, read a Criminal Profile guide first: EGamers notes PowerPyx and GTABase both say 'Irredeemable' is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known, so no confirmed method exists in the launch-day guides. The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something you failed once; keep it in mind while you play and check back when guides confirm it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? GTABase's unconfirmed guess is a strange event somewhere in Leonida, and PowerPyx marks the method as not yet known. Watch for odd encounters while exploring; do not chase a specific spot until a guide confirms one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx marks the steps as not yet known; the description points to a drive-by melee attack, most likely at the bowling alley, but no method is confirmed in the launch-day guides.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through fences; GTABase reports one fence pays the most, and the total grows during the robberies you do for the 100% checklist. Keep laundering as you earn.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Ordinary shopping counts and it adds up across the whole game, so buy gear, clothes and vehicles as you play instead of saving it for a grind at the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count, so buy the 8 that are actually for sale.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register any 10 vehicles you find in the app; it pairs well with Whip It Good, since you are already scanning vehicles as you travel.
trophies.name: On the Spot
